# Support

Snug is maintained by one person. Support is best-effort: there is no response
time guarantee, and issues are answered as time allows.

- **Read the docs first.** The [website](https://snug.andryore.dev/) and
  [`docs/`](../docs/README.md) cover installing, exporting, importing and
  scheduled backups. For problems building or testing the project, see
  [`docs/troubleshooting.md`](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
- **Bugs, feature requests and documentation errors:** open an issue with the
  matching [issue form](https://github.com/andryorelabs/snug/issues/new/choose).
  Search the
  [existing issues](https://github.com/andryorelabs/snug/issues?q=is%3Aissue)
  first.
- **Security vulnerabilities:** report them privately as described in
  [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md). Do not open a public issue.

To contribute a change, read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
